# Getting started

The notes service stores notes in SQLite and exposes a small HTTP API.

```mermaid
graph TD
  A[Client] --> B[API]
  B --> C[(SQLite)]
```

## Storing a note

POST a note body to `/notes`. The service assigns an id and returns it.
